prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Meet Your New Desktop Companion", "Select a pet to preview their idle animations and sound effects before adopting."]
1: ["Save Your Pet Companion to the Cloud", "Sign in now to lock in your pet selection and sync progress across devices.", "Save & Continue"]
2: ["Desktop Display & Overlay Test", "Checking system permissions to make sure your pet can roam freely on top of desktop windows.", "Desktop Overlay Authorization", "Confirm Desktop View"]
3: ["Try Your Pet Controls Now", "Click on your desktop pet to open commands, drag to move, or right-click to hide.", "Interactive Pet Target", "Right-click your pet anytime to access options or send them to the system tray."]
4: ["Creating Your Custom Desktop Pet", "Building 3D meshes, rendering animations, and optimizing desktop performance.", "This takes around 1-2 minutes. Your pet will spawn automatically when finished."]
5: ["Use clear, well-lit frontal photos with a single subject for best AI generation results.", "Tip: Avoid blurry images, group photos, or heavy filters."]
6: ["Choose Your Adoption Experience", "Pick a ready-to-play pet (1 min setup) or create a custom pet from photos (3 min setup).", "You can always create additional custom pets later from the main app menu."]
7: ["Link Account to Prevent Pet Loss", "Signing in binds your adopted pets safely to your account so you never lose them when switching devices.", "Safe Cloud Backup Included"]
8: ["Feel Free to Minimize", "We'll notify you desktop-side as soon as your pet is ready to leap onto your screen.", "Notify Me When Ready"]
9: ["Explore Companion Characters", "Compare pet traits and pick the companion that best matches your desk vibe."]

verdicts.problem: creates urgency to sign in to lock in pet selection
